title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: The group text
hook: How many messages are in your team group text this week?
intro: One question turns into forty replies.
statement: A group chat helps until it becomes noise.
q1: Do you use the group text for announcements only —
q2: or let it be an open chat for families?
q3: Where do important updates get lost?
t1: Both can work. But families stay informed
t2: when key messages are easy to find.
cta: Coaches — how do you run your group text?
ctaLines: Coach posts only. Open chat. A team app.
ctaPrompt: Share your communication habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How many messages are in your team group text this week?
One question turns into forty replies. The important update gets buried.
A group chat helps until it becomes noise.
Announcements only or open chat. There is no single right way.
How do you run your group text? Share your habit in the comments.
